name: Love & Piss ~Shoujo no Gaman ga Sekai o Sukuu~
original_name: Love＆Piss ～少女のガマンが世界を救う～
source:
In this world, your magic power increases by holding your pee. Yurika is a magician who severely lacks pee and decided to summon a guy who is able to store a lot of it so that he can supply her with it through a special ceremony (sexual intercourse) and allow her to pass the make-up wizard test. Yoshifumi was the chosen one and was forced to help her out since he couldn’t return to his own world until she becomes a wizard. Also, his childhood friend Yumari was also brought to this world at the same time, and for some reason she is also taking the wizard test with Yurika.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
在这个世界里，通过憋尿，你的魔力会增加。尤里卡是一位严重缺乏尿液的魔法师，她决定召唤一个能够储存大量尿液的人，以便他可以通过特殊的仪式（性交）为她提供尿液，并让她通过化妆巫师测试。吉文是被选中的人，他被迫帮助她，因为在她成为巫师之前他无法回到自己的世界。另外，他的青梅竹马尤玛丽也同时被带到了这个世界，不知为何她也和尤里卡一起参加巫师考试。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
